title: Add CSV rerun advanced rules
summary: Added a backend-owned CSV rerun remediation rule layer, preview/result evidence fields, scoped CSV rule evidence columns, and Queue display of rule labels/reasons while preserving the dedicated /api/rerun/* execution path.
reason: CSV rerun needs first-class advanced remediation policy decisions for audit rows without moving media policy into WebView JavaScript or converting rerun rows into normal pipeline queue rows.
behavior_before: CSV rerun preview validated source paths and lifecycle modes but did not expose a named remediation rule/policy decision per row. Queue result rows showed status and destination evidence but not a backend-owned rule reason.
behavior_after: CSV rerun preview classifies each row into explicit backend rules, blocks bad-download/manual/missing-input rows conservatively, carries rule fields into scoped CSVs when written, and Queue displays backend-provided rule labels/reasons/destination evidence on rerun rows.
manual_validation: python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static_launch tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_web_static -q -- failed in pre-existing broad static checks: Launch tab order assertion and Pending Publish local_file open-target coverage
rollback_plan: Remove src/mediapipeline/core/processes/rerun_rules.py, revert the rerun_preview/rerun_results rule field wiring, remove the Queue/preview rule rendering snippets, and restore the route/state/test inventory text to the prior CSV rerun preview/result contracts.
